headline: Ausom Enterprise appoints Shivani Pathak as company secretary
summary: Ausom Enterprise has announced the appointment of Shivani Pathak as its new company secretary. The filing details the leadership change for the firm. Retail investors can view this as a routine compliance update for the company. Such administrative changes typically have minimal impact on share price movement.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate financial impact.

headline: Ausom Enterprise appoints a new company secretary and compliance officer
summary: Ausom Enterprise Limited has formally informed the stock exchanges about the appointment of a new company secretary and compliance officer.
